boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Mississippi State University
boards.description: Ten currently documented food and essentials stops on campus or in nearby Starkville, all suitable for under-21 visitors.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 207 Highway 12 West, Starkville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late pickup; confirm the current service option before leaving, since dine-in ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 12 drive-thru option with the latest documented hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 207 Highway 12 West.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are earlier.

cards.title: Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 100 Highway 12 East, Starkville
cards.notes: Choose carryout or the drive-thru for a straightforward late meal, and check the location page again if a holiday or weather event is active.
cards.short_summary: An every-night option documented through 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6 a.m.–1 a.m. daily at 100 Highway 12 East.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed open until 1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 911 Highway 12 West, Starkville
cards.notes: Plan for carryout or delivery and place the order before the posted cutoff; the weekend schedule extends later than the weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Pizza carryout or delivery with midnight hours most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 911 Highway 12 West.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino’s
cards.subtitle: 101 Highway 12, Starkville
cards.notes: Order through the store page for delivery or carryout, then verify its live closing time because Domino’s notes that hours vary by location.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza option whose official page showed service until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Starkville store page identifies the 101 Highway 12 location and showed it open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official store page showed the location open until 1 a.m.; it advises checking the page for up-to-date hours.

cards.title: Cook Out
cards.subtitle: 102 MS-12, Starkville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or takeout service for a late food stop, and check the restaurant’s current listing before a very late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 12 fast-food stop documented into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Cook Out at 102 MS-12 with hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cook Out — Apple Maps place page
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Uno Mas Tacos & Tequila
cards.subtitle: 106 Maxwell Street, Starkville
cards.notes: Visit for the food service rather than alcohol; Thursday through Saturday have the latest posted closing time, with earlier hours on other nights.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant option on Maxwell Street with 1 a.m. weekend-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Uno Mas lists its Starkville location at 106 Maxwell Street and hours until 1 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Starkville
cards.subtitle: 701 Highway 12 East, Starkville
cards.notes: This is an earlier-evening run: use the drive-thru before 10 p.m. Monday through Saturday and note that the restaurant closes Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A nationally familiar Highway 12 stop with a documented 10 p.m. drive-thru close.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists its Starkville drive-thru open 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday; the restaurant is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Maroon Market at Azalea Dining
cards.subtitle: Inside Azalea Dining, Mississippi State campus
cards.notes: Use the self-service market for snacks, drinks, or essentials at any hour; bring an accepted campus payment method or card.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour campus market inside Azalea Dining.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Dining states that a 24-hour Maroon Market is available inside Azalea Dining for snacks, drinks, and essentials anytime.
cards.access_notes: MSU Dining describes the Maroon Market inside Azalea Dining as available 24 hours.

cards.title: Maroon Market at Griffis Hall
cards.subtitle: Griffis Hall, Mississippi State campus
cards.notes: Use this self-checkout market for a late essential or snack, and follow residence-hall access rules when entering the building.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour self-checkout market on the MSU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mississippi State identifies the Maroon Market at Griffis Hall as remaining open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Mississippi State — Winter Weather Tips and Resources
cards.access_notes: MSU’s January 2026 notice says the Griffis Hall Maroon Market remains open 24 hours.

cards.title: McDonald’s
cards.subtitle: 505 Highway 12 East, Starkville
cards.notes: Check the live ordering page before departing, then use pickup if available; the page documents continuous service for this Highway 12 location.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours fast-food pickup option on the east side of Highway 12.
cards.evidence_claim: Uber Eats lists McDonald’s at 505 Highway 12 East in Starkville as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The current ordering page lists this location as open 24 hours.
